name: Diboo signature pad
description: Allows for signature pad to be used as a drawing tool.
project_description: Diboo signature pad is a small addon for the Diboo ecosystem (built on diboo_core). It carries no configuration UI, entities, routes, services, permissions, or config schema of its own. Its entire behaviour is a single hook_entity_form_display_alter() implementation that swaps the widget for the diboo_image field on the diboo_chain_link form mode to the signature_pad widget (supplied by the separate signature_pad contrib module), with a fixed set of pre-tuned widget settings so chain links are captured as a hand-drawn PNG rather than an uploaded file. It is the first Diboo module that enables drawing.
